info.title: IronixPay API
info.description:
# IronixPay API

Welcome to the **IronixPay API**. Build crypto payment integrations with our REST API.

## Base URL
- **Production**: `https://api.ironixpay.com`
- **Sandbox**: `https://sandbox.ironixpay.com`

## Authentication
Include your API key in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_your_api_key
```

## Supported Tokens & Networks

| Token | Networks |
|-------|----------|
| USDT  | TRON, BSC, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism |
| USDC  | BSC, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism |

> **Sandbox**: TRON Nile testnet (USDT only).

## Amount Convention

All amounts across the API are represented as **human-readable decimal strings**.

| Example | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| `"10"` | 10 USDT/USDC |
| `"10.5"` | 10.5 USDT/USDC |
| `"0.01"` | Minimum precision (0.01) |

- **Minimum**: `0.01`
- **Maximum**: `10,000,000`

## Webhooks
Configure a webhook URL to receive real-time notifications:
- `checkout_session.paid` — Payment confirmed
- `checkout_session.expired` — Session expired
- `checkout_session.underpaid` — Partial payment detected
- `checkout_session.overpaid` — Excess payment detected
- `payout.completed` — Payout confirmed on-chain
- `payout.failed` — Payout failed

All webhook payloads include an `X-Webhook-Signature` header for verification.

get.description: Lists sessions for the authenticated merchant, with optional filtering.

parameters.name: search_text
parameters.description: Search by session ID, tx hash, or pay address

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status (e.g. `Pending`, `Paid`, `Expired`). Supports multiple values via repeated parameter.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Filter sessions created after this ISO 8601 datetime

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Filter sessions created before this ISO 8601 datetime

parameters.name: sub_merchant_code
parameters.description: Filter to a specific sub-merchant code

post.description:
Creates a new payment session. Returns a `url` for redirecting the customer
to the hosted checkout page.

Supports `Idempotency-Key` header for safe retries.
If the same key is used with the same request body, returns cached response.
If the same key is used with different request body, returns 409 Conflict.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional unique key for idempotent requests (recommended: UUID v4)

parameters.name: X-Sub-Merchant-Code
parameters.description: Sub-merchant code for PSP context switch. When provided, the session is created under the specified sub-merchant.

error.message: Amount must be at least 1 USDT
Idempotency key was used with a different request body

get.description:
Retrieves the details of an existing session, including associated
on-chain transactions.
Lists payouts for the authenticated merchant.

post.description:
Creates a new payout to the specified address.

The payout is created in `Pending` status and processed asynchronously.
The Payout Worker will broadcast the on-chain transaction and update status.

**Requires `Idempotency-Key` header** (recommended: UUID v4).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for idempotent requests (recommended: UUID v4)

error.message: Insufficient balance: have 5.00 USDT, need 10.00 USDT
Idempotency key already used for a different payout
Sub-merchant code '_self' is reserved and cannot be used

code.description: A short machine-readable code indicating the specific error.

doc_url.description: A URL to more information about the error code reported.

message.description: A human-readable message providing more details about the error.

param.description: If the error is parameter-specific, the parameter related to the error.

type.description: The type of error. One of `api_error`, `invalid_request_error`, `idempotency_error`.

sub_merchant_code.description: Unique code for this sub-merchant (e.g. `shop_tokyo`). Must not start with `_`.

amount.description:
Amount in standard units as a decimal string (e.g., "10.50" = 10.50 USDT).
Min: 1, Max: 10,000,000, Precision: 0.01.

to_address.description: Destination address on the specified network.

cancel_url.description:
The URL the customer is redirected to if they cancel or the session expires. Must be a valid, absolute URL.
Optional — if omitted, the hosted checkout page will show a generic expiry message instead of redirecting.

client_reference_id.description:
A unique string to reference this Checkout Session on your system, such as an order ID or cart ID.
Can be used to reconcile the session with your internal records. Maximum 200 characters.

currency.description:
The on-chain settlement token. This is the crypto token the customer actually pays
and the merchant receives on-chain.

Supported: `USDT`, `USDC`.
USDC requires a compatible `network` (not TRON, not Sandbox).

network.description:
The blockchain network to use. All 7 networks are available in **production** (`sk_live_`).
**Sandbox** (`sk_test_`) currently only supports `TRON` (mapped to TRON Nile testnet).
Must match the environment of the API key used for authentication.

pricing_amount.description:
The amount in `pricing_currency` units, as a decimal string.

When `pricing_currency` is crypto (= `currency`): the exact token amount to collect.
When `pricing_currency` is fiat: the fiat amount; the system converts
using real-time exchange rates.

Examples: `"10.50"`, `"100"`.
Crypto: min 1.00, max 10,000,000.00, precision 0.01.
Fiat: must be positive; minimum enforced after conversion (≥ 1 crypto equivalent).

pricing_currency.description:
The pricing/denomination currency code.

**Crypto** (`USDT`, `USDC`): direct token pricing — must equal `currency`.
**Fiat** (`USD`, `CNY`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `KRW`, `SGD`, `HKD`, `TWD`, `RUB`):
the system converts to the settlement token at the current exchange rate.

success_url.description:
The URL the customer is redirected to after a successful payment. Must be a valid, absolute URL.
Optional — if omitted, the hosted checkout page will show a generic success message instead of redirecting.

Network.description:
Supported blockchain networks.

**Production** (`sk_live_`): All networks are supported.
**Sandbox** (`sk_test_`): Currently only `TRON` is supported (maps to TRON Nile testnet).

livemode.description: Whether this is a live or sandbox payout

status.description: Current status: Pending, Processing, Completed, Failed

sub_merchant_code.description: Sub-merchant code (None if belongs to parent merchant directly)

PricingInfo.description:
Pricing snapshot — always present. For crypto-only sessions, pricing_currency
equals the settlement currency (e.g., "USDT") and exchange_rate is "1".

amount.description: The original amount in the pricing currency (e.g., "10.50").

exchange_rate.description: The exchange rate at session creation (1 crypto = N fiat, or "1" for crypto-only).

amount.description: The total amount expected for this session, in standard units (e.g., `"10.5"` = 10.5 USDT).

amount_received.description: The total amount received so far, in standard units. Updated as on-chain payments are detected.

cancel_url.description: The URL the customer is redirected to if payment is cancelled or the session expires.

chain_family.description: Chain family for frontend polling dispatch ("tron" or "evm").

client_reference_id.description: The merchant's custom reference ID, if provided at session creation.

created_at.description: The time at which the session was created, in UTC (ISO 8601).

currency.description: The settlement token code (always a crypto token: `USDT` or `USDC`).

currency_contract.description:
USDT/USDC contract address for this network/environment.
Used by frontend for wallet deeplinks and payment detection polling.

detection_rpc_url.description: Public RPC URL for frontend payment detection polling.

expires_at.description: The time at which the session expires and no longer accepts payments, in UTC (ISO 8601).

fee_amount.description:
The platform fee deducted, in standard units (e.g., `"1"` = 1 USDT).
Only populated for completed sessions (Paid/Overpaid).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Checkout Session, prefixed with `cs_`.

merchant_logo_url.description:
Merchant logo URL for white-label checkout branding.
Only present when the merchant has uploaded a logo.

merchant_name.description: The display name of the merchant who created this session.

net_amount.description:
The net amount credited to the merchant after fee deduction, in standard units.
Only populated for completed sessions (Paid/Overpaid).

pay_address.description: The payment address generated for this session. The customer sends tokens to this address.

pricing.description:
Pricing details. Always present. For crypto-only sessions, echoes the settlement
currency and amount. For fiat sessions, includes exchange rate details.

status.description: The current status of the session. See the session lifecycle documentation for details.

sub_merchant_code.description:
Sub-merchant code if this session was created via PSP context switch.
Only present for sub-merchant sessions.

success_url.description: The URL the customer is redirected to after successful payment.

transactions.description:
List of on-chain transactions associated with this session.
Only populated when retrieving a single session by ID.

url.description: The URL of the hosted checkout page. Redirect the customer to this URL to complete payment.

sub_merchant_code.description: The unique code identifying this sub-merchant (e.g. `shop_tokyo`).

amount.description: The transfer amount in standard units (e.g., `"10.5"` = 10.5 USDT).

created_at.description: The time at which the transaction was detected, in UTC (ISO 8601 format, e.g. `2026-02-11T03:56:00Z`).

network.description:
The blockchain network this transaction occurred on (e.g., `"TRON"`, `"BSC"`, `"ETHEREUM"`).
May differ from the session's network in cross-chain exception resolution cases.

tx_hash.description: The on-chain transaction hash. Can be used to look up the transaction on a block explorer (e.g. Tronscan).

bearer_auth.description: API key authentication. Use `sk_test_...` for sandbox or `sk_live_...` for production.
